content.short: Sigma is a DeFi trading bot and web terminal for fast, MEV-protected token swaps across chains.
content.description: Sigma is a trading companion for DeFi traders, available as a Telegram bot and as a web trading terminal. It focuses on speed, MEV protection and built-in bridging, so users can buy and sell tokens faster than swapping manually from a wallet. Its site lists Ethereum, Base, Avalanche, BNB Chain, Unichain and Solana as supported chains.
content.meta: Sigma is a Telegram bot and web terminal for fast, MEV-protected trading on Ethereum, Base, Unichain, Solana and more.
